gloss: in the midst of; in the middle of; at the height of

definitions.gloss: in the midst of, in the middle of, at the height of
definitions.explanation: Refers to the very middle of an ongoing action, event, or season. Often emphasizes that something is at its peak or most intense point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The phone rang in the middle of the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A power outage happened at the height of summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{友|とも}だち⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{誘|さそ}い→誘い：14200_sasoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧、⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}→集中：03212_shuuchuu⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A friend contacted me with an invitation while I was in the middle of studying for exams, so I couldn't concentrate.

notes:
READING NOTE: The same kanji {最中|さいちゅう} (read さいちゅう) is more commonly used in everyday speech, especially in the pattern 〜⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧{最中|さいちゅう}. The reading さなか is more literary.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the midst of ...
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さなか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in the middle of ...

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最中|さなか}: literary, emphasizes being at the peak or critical point
- {最中|さいちゅう}: neutral, common in everyday speech
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧: in the middle of (a process, journey)
